enums.name: DeviceRole
enums.description: Device roles define intended use for the whole device and the type of the device.
enums.python_description: The functional role of a Simucube device in the hardware setup, such as wheelbase, pedal, or button box.

values.name: hub
values.description: Device exists to allow connecting other devices

values.name: unknown
values.description: Device's current role isn't known. For example ActivePedal before initial configuration.

values.name: other
values.description: Used when the device role is some other than what is supported by this API version

enums.name: ControlType
enums.description:
Control types define the physical controls of the devices.

Controls are physical features of the device.

This enum and its numeric ids will change between SC-API versions.
Use textual representation to refer these instead of enumerator numeric values.
enums.python_description: Physical control type of a component on a device, such as a pedal, button, hat switch, or rotary encoder.

values.name: wheelbase
values.description: This control is a wheelbase.

values.name: wheel
values.description: Wheel that is connected to the wheelbase

values.name: pedal
values.description: Pedal that is intended for pressing with a foot

values.name: paddle
values.description: Paddle switch

values.name: hat_switch
values.description: Hat switch

values.name: button
values.description: Button

values.name: toggle_switch
values.description: Toggle switch

values.name: dir_2way
values.description: Two way directional switch (2 digital inputs)

values.name: dir_4way
values.description: Four way directional switch (4 digital inputs)

values.name: rot_enc
values.description: Rotary encoder

values.name: funky_switch
values.description: Combination of button, 4-way directional and rotary encoder

values.name: light
values.description: Controllable light. Only for feedback and doesn't function as input.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Used as placeholder for unavailable data.

values.name: other
values.description: Used when the control type is some other than what is supported by this API version

enums.name: FeedbackType
enums.description:
Feedback types define how the simulator can interract with the devices.


This enum and its numeric ids will change between SC-API versions.
Use textual representation to refer these instead of enumerator numeric values.
enums.python_description: Output/feedback mechanism type of a device component, such as a direct-input wheelbase, active pedal, or RGB light.

values.name: direct_input
values.description: DirectInput HID force feedback support

values.name: wheelbase
values.description: Force feedback effect pipelines

values.name: active_pedal
values.description: ActivePedal

values.name: rgb_light
values.description: Fully controllable rgb light

values.name: light
values.description: Light that can only be turned on or off

values.name: unknown
values.description: Placeholder for unavailable data.

values.name: other
values.description: Used when the feedback type is some other than what is supported by this API version

enums.name: InputRole
enums.description:
Input roles define intended usage of the input source

This should be used to map device inputs to game controls.

This enum and its numeric ids will change between SC-API versions.
Use textual representation to refer these instead of enumerator numeric values.
enums.python_description: Semantic role of a device input, identifying its in-game function such as steering, throttle, brake, or a specific car control action.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Used for inputs that are mapped to some type of input, but it is unknown

values.name: unmapped
values.description: Used for inputs that are missing dynamic mapping to a control

values.name: other
values.description: Used when the input role is some other than what is supported by this API version

enums.name: InputType
enums.description:
Input types define how the input is represented in this API

This should be used determine how the input values should be read from this API.

This enum and its numeric ids will change between SC-API versions.
Use textual representation to refer these instead of enumerator numeric values.
enums.python_description: Physical input mechanism type of a device component, such as an analog axis, button, or rotary encoder.

values.name: axis
values.description: Analog axis

values.name: button
values.description: Digital input that is briefly activated when user interracts with it

values.name: inc_rot_enc
values.description: Incremental rotary encoder

values.name: abs_rot_enc
values.description: Absolute rotary encoder

values.name: unknown
values.description: Used as placeholder for unavailable data.

values.name: other
values.description: Used when the input type is some other than what is supported by this API version
